name: Earthen Redoubt
primary:
A half ring of earth covers your front and flanks.
A 2-high half ring of wall with a 3-block radius facing the aim point: the top of the arc stands where you aim, each column settling on the ground. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description: A 2-high half ring of wall with a 3-block radius facing the aim point: the top of the arc stands where you aim, each column settling on the ground. Material: magic earth, permanent. No extra effects.
